name: citation-support-verbatim
description: citation-support@2 as a verbatim instrument: the same per-locus support judgment (one claim at one citation locus against one cited work, exact quotes from supplied evidence units, explicit escalation) with citation-support@2's prompt, output schema, validator and class map unchanged, and with its request settings declared per tier and one item per call, so that the run principal's broker can check every call against the installed bundle and send it unchanged.
unit: claim at one citation locus against one cited work

abstract.population: loci of the frozen follow-up strata

geometry.note: citation-support@2 requires calibration above one item per call, so every call carries one item

repair.scope: items without a valid output after the first call

full-text.population: loci of the frozen follow-up strata

evidencePolicy.evidence: supplied full-text units with explicit coverage
evidencePolicy.absence: not-addressed only with complete full-text coverage

geometry.note: citation-support@2 requires calibration above one item per call, so every call carries one item

repair.scope: items without a valid output after the first call

notes: The prompt and output schema are citation-support@2's files under the same digests, the validator and builder are its module (corpus_assessment, pinned here by sha256) and the class map is citation-support@2's; citation-support@2 stays registered unchanged.

Declared here, where citation-support@2 leaves them to the caller: the request settings of each tier (temperature zero, no seed, reasoning off at the abstract tier and low at the full-text tier, the output-token rule), one item per call, the required served model (another served model pauses the run) and the verbatim message transport. Each tier exports its own broker bundle (ocsl-review instruments export citation-support-verbatim@1 --tier abstract|full-text).
A change of any setting, the served model included, is another instrument version.
